run.grain: one distinct held candidate tile type per defender decision
run.copy_weighting: none; physical copies never duplicate a candidate observation
run.turn_axes: observer_turn, riichi_player_turn, turns_since_riichi, and all_turns; turns_since_riichi is riichi_player_turn minus declaration turn
run.safety: genbutsu uses observed safe_types only; honors are separate; suited suji uses same-suit rank plus or minus three, with both anchors required for double_suji on 4/5/6
run.ron_scope: target riichi ron only; non-target dama ron omitted
run.stopping_rule: second legal riichi declaration or target ron/tsumo, defender tsumo, exhaustion
run.opponent_policy: attack throughout; no folding, cheap-bad-wait rejection, or valuable-dama filtering
run.safe_information: target river including declaration; all safely passed post-declaration discards; no other players' pre-declaration rivers
run.scoring: binary target ron eligibility; no point-value scoring
run.uncertainty: pooled ratio with independent-table cluster standard error; zero-exposure tables included in G
